item.title: Trump forms committee to examine Fed Governor Lisa Cook over mortgage fraud claims
item.description: A new White House committee created by President Donald Trump will hold a closed hearing on mortgage fraud allegations against Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook.

item.title: Trump selects Karoline Leavitt's successor, a seasoned fighter
FCC chair defers to Hegseth on execution TV broadcast
item.description: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr said Friday he would leave the decision on whether television networks could broadcast an execution to War Secretary Pete Hegseth.

item.title: Democrat shifts stance on trans athletes as Trump targets past record
item.description: South Carolina Senate candidate Annie Andrews says she was misrepresented on transgender sports after Trump called her "Annie Trannie."
